title: The + tooltip and menu look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "card-07-n1-add-tip.png" (board 1.7) and "card-08-n1-add-menu.png" (board 1.8) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the + and compare with the picture of board 1.7.
  2. Click the + and compare with the picture of board 1.8.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the tooltip "Add representative" shows where the picture shows it, without covering the field.
  • Step 2: the menu opens below the + with one option, "Sales Representative - Parts"; the + keeps its light fill and the tooltip is gone, as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R2: “At rest the icon is grey on no fill. Hovering the button shows a light fill. The light fill stays while its menu is open.”
  • S2-R3: “Hovering the + shows the tooltip "Add representative". The tooltip does not show while the menu is open.”
  • S2-R4: “Clicking the + opens a menu below it with one option, "Sales Representative - Parts". Clicking outside the menu or pressing Escape closes it without a change.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
